faq.question: What does Rashidi mean?
faq.answer: Rashidi is associated with the Arabic form رَشِيدِي, whose core sense is rashidi; rightly guided (swahili form).

faq.question: What is the origin of Rashidi?
faq.answer: Rashidi is associated with Arabic. Rashidi is the Swahili form of Arabic رَشِيد (Rashīd), meaning 'rightly guided'.

faq.question: Is Rashidi an Arabic name?
faq.answer: Yes — the underlying form رَشِيدِي is Arabic.

faq.question: Is Rashidi an Islamic name?
faq.answer: Rashidi can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.question: Is Rashidi a Quranic name?
faq.answer: Rashidi should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Rashīd is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.question: What does Rashidi mean in Persian?
faq.answer: In Persian, Rashidi is rendered رشیدی and carries the sense رشیدی، هدایت‌یافته.

faq.answer: A romanized syllable approximation is ras-hi-di. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.question: What are the variants of Rashidi?
faq.answer: Romanization variants include Rashidi, rashidi. Script forms are رشيدي, رشیدی, رَشِيدِي, रशीदी.
